description: This figshare record holds two European layers: a building density map on a 100 by 100 metre grid, giving building footprint area in square metres per hectare for all of Europe, and a vector dataset of modelled rooftop area and technical and economic rooftop solar photovoltaic potential by region. They were deposited by Georgia Kakoulaki on 20 November 2020 as the data behind a study of rooftop photovoltaic potential in the European Union. Coverage is Europe for the density raster and European regions for the PV potential. Access: open download of two zip files, about 120 MB in all. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the record itself gives only a short description, so the method, input building layer and reference year must be taken from the associated paper; figures are regional aggregates, not per roof. Simulation uses: the density grid is a proxy for building exposure in hazard models and for heat and energy demand mapping, and the regional potentials feed rooftop solar deployment and energy system scenarios. Related records: GlobalBuildingAtlas and the Munich 3D solar potential dataset.
name: EU building density map (100 m) and regional rooftop PV potential
